summary: CRASH-FIX for fingerprint unlock verified (frontend static + runtime smoke). Both files lint clean (0 errors). Static analysis confirms all requested defensive changes: cancelAuthenticate() and dynamic import('expo-local-authentication') fully removed; biometricPrompt() options match spec (promptMessage, cancelLabel/fallbackLabel 'Use PIN', disableDeviceFallback: true); supportedAuthenticationTypesAsync wrapped in its own try/catch; commitUnlock() retains setTimeout+requestAnimationFrame; bioBusyRef preserved; single auto-trigger useEffect with 600ms delay; tryBiometric deps are [bio.hasFace, commitUnlock]. Runtime smoke on http://localhost:3000: app loads, guest login works, home renders, Profile screen renders, tapping App Lock row opens the Set-PIN modal successfully — no red-screen, ZERO console errors, ZERO references to cancelAuthenticate at runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: appLock.ts uses static `import * as LocalAuthentication from 'expo-local-authentication'` at top of file — safe (no dynamic import in useEffect cleanup, which was the crash suspect).
grep across both files confirms the only remaining occurrence of the string 'cancelAuthenticate' is a comment in appLock.ts explaining WHY it was removed — no runtime call.
commitUnlock's two-step deferral (setTimeout(0) → requestAnimationFrame) is correctly preserved for OEM window-manager quirks (Xiaomi/MIUI/Realme/ColorOS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real biometric hardware behaviour cannot be validated on the Expo web preview — the crash reported on Poco/Xiaomi/Realme can only be confirmed fixed on a physical device build. Static + runtime web checks are all green.
rca_of_issue: Original crash root cause (per main agent): (1) LocalAuthentication.cancelAuthenticate() call and (2) dynamic import('expo-local-authentication').then(mod => mod.cancelAuthenticate()) in an AppLockGate useEffect cleanup were throwing uncaught native exceptions on some Android OEMs (MIUI/ColorOS), tearing the JS bridge and dismissing the app to the home screen. Fix: both calls removed, biometricPrompt() simplified to a single defensively-wrapped authenticateAsync, disableDeviceFallback restored to prevent OS PIN overlay conflicts, and supportedAuthenticationTypesAsync wrapped independently. All verified present in code and lint-clean.
